desc:
⚔️ Click, train, and hunt anomalies!

Every swing makes you stronger. Enter the dungeon, defeat enemies, and use their drops to forge your next powerful sword!

💪 Click and train to gain Power
👾 Clear stages and unlock new areas
💎 Collect rare ores and forge stronger swords
🎒 Equip your best gear and sell what you don’t need
🔄 Rebirth and push your limits
👥 Play with friends for extra boosts
💤 Earn Power while you’re offline

Your next upgrade could be one adventure away. How far can you go?
